column1: # status: REVIEWED by the user (approved in a Claude Code session) on 2026-11-14
# Drafted 2026-11-14 from UniProt protein names (release 2026_04) following the unified histone variant nomenclature (Talbert et al. 2012, Epigenetics Chromatin 5:7) and HistoneDB 2.0 naming.
# category: canonical | canonical_divergent | tissue_specific | replacement_variant | putative. Default histone views use category == canonical only.
# cooccurrence_default: lysine co-occurrence defaults: one canonical representative per core family (H2A type 1, H2B type 1-C/E/F/G/I, H3.1, H4) plus H3.3 by explicit exception.
# Rows whose notes contain 'REVIEW:' are remaining judgment calls.
# After review, change the status line to: status: REVIEWED by <name> on <date>

column6: Replication-independent (replacement) linker histone. UniProt also lists an N-terminally processed form.
Replication-dependent (clustered gene) linker histone. REVIEW: expression is tissue-restricted (thymus, testis, spleen); tissue_specific may fit better.
Testis-specific linker histone (H1t2, HANP1). Initiator Met kept under the MetAP rule (residue 2 = E).
Putative spermatid-specific linker histone (HILS1); PE=5 (UniProt: H1.9 linker histone pseudogene). Initiator Met kept (residue 2 = L).
Replication-dependent (clustered gene); one protein from H2AC11, H2AC13, H2AC15, H2AC16, H2AC17. Reference canonical H2A; default H2A for lysine co-occurrence.
H2AC1 (HIST1H2AA); TH2A, testis-specific H2A (user decision 2026-11-14). 131 aa.
Replication-dependent (clustered gene); H2AC21. REVIEW: its C-terminal tail differs from H2A type 1 at 6 positions, so canonical_divergent may fit by the H2AC25 criterion.

Replication-dependent (clustered gene); H2AC25 (HIST3H2A). Differs from H2A type 1 (P0C0S8) at UniProt 17 (T>S), 41 (A>S), 100 (K>R), hence canonical_divergent (user rule 2026-11-14). The gene alias 'H2AW' is a legacy alias unrelated to the plant H2A.W variant.
H2AZ2 (UniProt name 'Histone H2A.V'); variant. Other splice isoforms (Q71UI9-2 to -5) are in the reference proteome but not in the histone set.
MACROH2A1 splice form macroH2A1.1: UniProt isoform 1 (mH2A1.1, isoform ID O75367-2), the displayed sequence; 369 aa. UniProt features (known marks) are annotated on this sequence.

MACROH2A1 splice form macroH2A1.2: UniProt isoform 2 (mH2A1.2, isoform ID O75367-1); 372 aa; residues 198-226 of macroH2A1.1 replaced by an alternative exon (32 aa). From data/histones/histone_isoforms.fasta (UniProt 2026_04). Isoform 3 (O75367-3) is not included.
H2AB2, H2AB3 (Barr body-deficient, H2A.Bbd); testis-enriched variant. No lysine features in UniProt.
Replication-dependent (clustered gene); one protein from H2BC4, H2BC6, H2BC7, H2BC8, H2BC10. Reference canonical H2B; default H2B for lysine co-occurrence.
H2BC1 (UniProt 'Histone H2B type 1-A', TSH2B); testis-specific despite its cluster-1 gene.

Replication-dependent (clustered gene); H2BC26 (alias H2BU1, 'H2B.U histone 1'). Differs from H2B type 1-C/E/F/G/I at 6 positions (UniProt 3, 5, 33, 40, 76, 95). canonical_divergent (user decision 2026-11-14).

H2BC12L ('H2B.S histone 1'); replacement variant (user decision 2026-11-14). Differs from H2B type 1-K at UniProt 28 (K>R) and 82 (A>P). K28R (mature 27) creates an Arg-C cleavage site after UniProt residue 28 (...DGR|KRKR...), so Arg-C-like (and propionylated-trypsin) peptides differ from canonical H2B there.
H2BC20P pseudogene product; PE=5 (uncertain existence); 193 aa.
H2BC19P pseudogene product; PE=5 (uncertain existence); 164 aa.
H2BW1 (UniProt 'Histone H2B type W-T'); testis-specific, 153 aa.
Replication-dependent (clustered gene); one protein from 10 genes (H3C1-H3C12). Default H3 for lysine co-occurrence.
Replication-dependent (clustered gene); H3C13, H3C14, H3C15. Differs from H3.1 only at UniProt 97 (C>S; mature 96).
H3-7 (formerly HIST2H3PS2, a pseudogene symbol); putative (user decision 2026-11-14). 4 substitutions vs H3.2 (UniProt 78, 97, 128, 129).

H3-3A, H3-3B; replication-independent variant. Not in the canonical-only default views, but kept as a lysine co-occurrence default by explicit exception (user decision 2026-11-14; CLAUDE.md section 8).
H3Y1 (H3.Y.1); primate-specific. REVIEW: limited expression (tissue_specific may fit).
H3Y2 (H3.Y.2, UniProt 'Histone H3.X'); primate-specific, 147 aa. REVIEW: limited expression (tissue_specific may fit).
CENPA; centromeric H3 variant. No lysine features in UniProt.
Replication-dependent (clustered gene); one protein from 14 genes (H4C1-H4C16). Default H4 for lysine co-occurrence.
